title: Action Recommendations for Sequentially Rational Strategic Agents
summary: We consider a finite-horizon discrete-time dynamic system that is jointly controlled by two strategic agents. There is a system designer that has its own reward function but does not have direct control over the agents' actions. We consider an information structure where the current state and all past history are equally accessible by the designer and the agents. The designer sends action recommendations to the agents at each time step. Each agent can use the received recommendation and the available information to choose its action.
